questions.question: ____ cannot be transported on a bus where passengers sit.
questions.explanation: Radioactive materials must never be carried in areas where passengers are. Other hazardous materials may be allowed under specific conditions.

questions.question: A pre-trip inspection should:

options.text: Be done the same way every time.
Not always include all items to check.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be done the same way every time.
questions.explanation: Do your pre-trip inspection the same way every time. This helps you remember all the steps and keeps you from skipping anything important.

questions.question: When you see a green light at a drawbridge, you should:

options.text: Wait for the light to turn yellow.

questions.explanation: A green light at a drawbridge means you can cross without stopping. Still slow down and check that it is safe before you proceed.

questions.question: When backing a truck, you should:

options.text: Use only the driver's side mirror.

questions.explanation: When backing, always use the mirrors on both sides of the truck. Get someone to help you whenever you can.

questions.question: If there is a cargo fire in a box trailer, you should:

options.text: Put a heavy blanket over the trailer.

questions.explanation: Do not open trailer doors during a cargo fire. Opening the doors gives the fire more oxygen and makes it larger.

questions.question: If you start a left turn before reaching the center of an intersection, you:

options.text: May hit other vehicles with the left side of your vehicle.
Can expect other drivers to move out of your way.

questions.correctAnswerText: May hit other vehicles with the left side of your vehicle.
questions.explanation: Reach the center of the intersection before you start your left turn. If you turn too early, the left side of your vehicle may hit another vehicle.

questions.question: If you feel sleepy while driving, you should:

options.text: Keep driving to finish your trip.
Drive faster to get there sooner.
Pull over and take a nap.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull over and take a nap.
questions.explanation: Stop driving and sleep if you feel tired. Trying to fight exhaustion is dangerous and causes crashes. Energy pills are not safe because they wear off and you will be even more tired.

questions.question: If a traffic light has been green for a long time, it will probably:
questions.explanation: When a light has been green for a long time, it will likely turn yellow soon. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: If a tire rim is damaged, it should be:

options.text: Moved to the farthest axle from the driver.

questions.explanation: Damaged rims should be replaced, not welded. Welded rims are not safe to use.

questions.question: Watching the road ahead of you:

options.text: Gives you time to plan how to avoid a hazard.
Is not recommended because it distracts you.
Is only important in heavy traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Gives you time to plan how to avoid a hazard.
questions.explanation: Always watch the road ahead. This gives you time to react to hazards before you reach them.

questions.question: A bus driver must:

options.text: Wear a seat belt only if passengers have seat belts.
Wear a seat belt, but it is not required.

questions.explanation: Bus drivers must always wear a seat belt while driving. The driver's seat has a seat belt that should be used at all times.

questions.question: If your heavy load is slowing you down, you should:
questions.explanation: The right lane is for slower traffic. If your heavy load is slowing you down, stay in the right lane.

questions.question: A thin layer of ice on road surfaces is called:
questions.explanation: Black ice is clear ice that lets you see the road through it. A road with black ice may look wet. Be very careful when it is below freezing and the road looks wet.

questions.question: When looking in your mirrors, check your tires to:

options.text: See if the tires are rolling properly.
Check if the tread is good.
Compare tire size to other vehicles.

questions.explanation: Check your tires regularly in your mirrors. This helps you spot a tire fire if one starts. Tire fires can happen when a tire is under-inflated, when dual tires touch, or when tires overheat.

questions.question: Steering wheel play should be no more than:
questions.explanation: A steering wheel should move no more than 10 degrees. This equals about two inches of movement on a 20-inch wheel. Too much play makes steering difficult.

questions.question: You should not use your mirrors to:

options.text: Check how fast you are going.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check how fast you are going.
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors often, especially when changing lanes, turning, merging, and making tight maneuvers. But do not use mirrors to check your speed.

questions.question: If you feel drowsy while driving, you should:

options.text: Keep driving to finish the trip.

questions.explanation: The only real cure for drowsiness is sleep. Caffeine and other drugs may help for a short time, but they do not keep you truly alert. You will get even more tired when the drugs wear off.

questions.question: When backing with a trailer, you should:

options.text: Not back up in a straight line.
Not correct drift until you are far off course.
Pull forward to reposition the vehicle as needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull forward to reposition the vehicle as needed.
questions.explanation: When backing with a trailer, pull forward to reposition your vehicle as needed.

questions.question: To overcome blind spot challenges, you should:

options.text: Drive faster so other drivers cannot pass you.
Drive in the left lane to only watch vehicles on your right.
Check your mirrors often and watch where other vehicles are.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your mirrors often and watch where other vehicles are.
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors often to watch traffic around you. This helps you notice when vehicles move into your blind spots.

questions.question: If your coolant level is low, you should:
questions.explanation: Check your oil level, coolant level, and windshield washer fluid when inspecting the engine. The engine needs enough coolant in both cold and hot weather.
